parsed.summary: The proposed patch optimizes the .delete() method to fetch only the primary key fields, which should resolve the UnicodeDecodeError encountered during the deletion process.

issues.description: The patch does not address the root cause of the UnicodeDecodeError. It only optimizes the query to fetch fewer fields, which may not resolve the encoding issue.
The patch introduces a comment that does not follow the project's coding style conventions.
